// diagnostic

E0921

A reachable call violates a rights-tree memory denial; the transitive proof names the source operation, full call path, denial spelling, and provenance

What

A reachable call violates a rights-tree memory denial; the transitive proof names the source operation, full call path, denial spelling, and provenance

Why

A memory denial holds for everything its scope calls, so a call reaching a denied operation breaks it

Fix

Grant the required memory right or move the call outside the denied boundary.
